logical_model.summary: Logical design for datamodel, derived from the conceptual model. 20 entities carry 23 relationships: 2 associative entities resolve many-to-many relationships and 2 entities are identified through a parent. 0 entities required a surrogate identifier because no business key was recorded. Attributes are typed against abstract domains and carry no platform-specific length, precision or storage.

subject_areas.name: Sales & Customer Management
subject_areas.description: Manages customers, their orders, and the sales representatives who service them.

subject_areas.name: Product & Inventory
subject_areas.description: Manages product catalog, supplier relationships, categories, and stock levels across warehouses.

subject_areas.name: Order Fulfillment
subject_areas.description: Manages the complete order lifecycle: line items, payments, shipments, and returns.

subject_areas.name: Promotions
subject_areas.description: Manages promotional campaigns and their associations with products.

subject_areas.name: Geography & Organization
subject_areas.description: Defines organizational structure, reporting hierarchies, and geographic locations.

subject_areas.name: System Administration
subject_areas.description: Tracks data changes and system operations.

entities.name: Audit Log
entities.description: A system record of data operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) for compliance and audit purposes.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: A classification grouping related products together (e.g., Accessories, Storage).

entities.name: City
entities.description: A city or municipal area serving as a location for customers and warehouses.

entities.name: Country
entities.description: A nation recognized for business and geographic purposes.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A person or business entity that purchases products. Customers have credit limits and geographic locations.

entities.name: Department
entities.description: An organizational unit grouping employees by function.

entities.name: Employee
entities.description: A member of the organization who may be a sales representative or manager. Employees have departments and report to managers.

entities.name: Inventory
entities.description: The quantity of a product held at a specific warehouse, with reorder thresholds.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A request by a customer to purchase products, recorded with order date and status. May be assigned to a sales representative.

entities.name: Order Item
entities.description: A line item within an order, specifying a product, quantity, and unit price at the time of order.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A financial transaction recording payment received for an order via a specified payment method.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: A tangible item offered for sale, with a SKU, unit price, category, and supplier. Has active/inactive status.

entities.name: Product Promotion Association
entities.description: Resolves the many-to-many relationship between Product and Promotion. Each occurrence records that one Product references one Promotion.

entities.name: Product Warehouse Association
entities.description: Resolves the many-to-many relationship between Product and Warehouse. Each occurrence records that one Product references one Warehouse.

entities.name: Promotion
entities.description: A time-bound or product-bound marketing campaign offering a discount.

entities.name: Return Order
entities.description: A product return request tied to an original order, including the return reason.

entities.name: Shipment
entities.description: A fulfillment record tracking the dispatch of an order from a warehouse with a tracking number.

entities.name: State
entities.description: A provincial or state-level geographic subdivision of a country.

entities.name: Supplier
entities.description: An external party that provides products to the business.

entities.name: Warehouse
entities.description: A physical location where inventory is stored and orders are fulfilled.

normalization_actions.action: Resolved many-to-many between Product and Promotion
normalization_actions.rationale: A many-to-many relationship cannot be represented without a repeating group. An associative entity keyed on both parents removes the repetition and gives the relationship a place to carry its own attributes later.

normalization_actions.action: Resolved many-to-many between Product and Warehouse
normalization_actions.rationale: A many-to-many relationship cannot be represented without a repeating group. An associative entity keyed on both parents removes the repetition and gives the relationship a place to carry its own attributes later.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Inventory has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, reorder_level) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Identified Inventory as dependent on Warehouse
normalization_actions.rationale: Its business key includes Warehouse's key (warehouse_name), so it cannot be identified independently. The relationship is identifying and the key is propagated rather than duplicated.

normalization_actions.action: Checked non-key attributes against the full composite key
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Item has a composite key, so every non-key attribute (quantity, unit_price) must depend on the whole key rather than part of it. No partial dependency was found.

normalization_actions.action: Identified Order Item as dependent on Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Its business key includes Order's key (order_id), so it cannot be identified independently. The relationship is identifying and the key is propagated rather than duplicated.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed State attributes are not repeated on City
normalization_actions.rationale: City references State, which references Country. The chain is already decomposed, so Country's attributes reach City by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed City attributes are not repeated on Customer
normalization_actions.rationale: Customer references City, which references State. The chain is already decomposed, so State's attributes reach Customer by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Inventory
normalization_actions.rationale: Inventory references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Inventory by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Employee attributes are not repeated on Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Order references Employee, which references Department. The chain is already decomposed, so Department's attributes reach Order by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Product attributes are not repeated on Order Item
normalization_actions.rationale: Order Item references Product, which references Category. The chain is already decomposed, so Category's attributes reach Order Item by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Order attributes are not repeated on Payment
normalization_actions.rationale: Payment references Order, which references Employee. The chain is already decomposed, so Employee's attributes reach Payment by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Product Warehouse Association
normalization_actions.rationale: Product Warehouse Association references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Product Warehouse Association by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Product attributes are not repeated on Return Order
normalization_actions.rationale: Return Order references Product, which references Category. The chain is already decomposed, so Category's attributes reach Return Order by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed Warehouse attributes are not repeated on Shipment
normalization_actions.rationale: Shipment references Warehouse, which references City. The chain is already decomposed, so City's attributes reach Shipment by navigation rather than by duplication.

normalization_actions.action: Confirmed City attributes are not repeated on Warehouse
normalization_actions.rationale: Warehouse references City, which references State. The chain is already decomposed, so State's attributes reach Warehouse by navigation rather than by duplication.
